title: Kestrel Med Sync Sync-Day Settings (Auto Refill & Medication Sync)
content:
The sync day is the day of the month to which Auto Refill & Medication Sync cycles align. Each program sets who chooses it, the earliest and latest day of the month allowed, how often it may be changed in a program year, and how a new prescription joining mid-cycle is handled.

| Program | How the sync day is chosen | Earliest day of the month allowed as a sync day | Latest day of the month allowed as a sync day | Times per program year the sync day may be changed | New prescription joining mid-cycle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0 | not applicable |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | chosen by the patient | 1 | 28 | 2 | short fill to the sync day |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | chosen by the patient | 1 | 28 | 2 | short fill to the sync day |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | chosen by the pharmacist | 1 | 28 | 1 | added at the next cycle |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0 | not applicable |

## Values used

- **How the sync day is chosen**: chosen by the patient, chosen by the pharmacist, or not applicable.
- **Earliest and latest day**: whole days of the month; both ends are allowed days. A figure of 0 appears only in the programs where no sync day applies.
- **Changes per program year**: a whole number of changes.
- **Mid-cycle handling**: short fill to the sync day, added at the next cycle, or not applicable.

## Questions the settings answer

**Which programs use a sync day at all?** Kestrel Med Sync Monthly, Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day and Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging. For Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day, Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day and Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill every sync-day setting reads not applicable or 0.

**Which days of the month can serve as a sync day?** In each of the three Med Sync programs, any day from the 1st through the 28th; the 29th, 30th and 31st cannot.

**Who picks the day?** The patient, in Kestrel Med Sync Monthly and Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day; the pharmacist, in Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging.

**How often can it change?** Up to 2 times per program year in Kestrel Med Sync Monthly and Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day, and once per program year in Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging.
